payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance improvements of the model over previous state-of-the-art systems, including percentage increases in F1-scores.

claims.text: The model outperforms previous state-of-the-art systems on the benchmark corpus of PDTB, improving the macro-average F1-score by over 7 percent compared to the baseline Bi-LSTM model.
The ensemble model achieves a performance boost of 3.02 in macro F1-score for predicting implicit discourse relations compared to single models.
